standard_prerequisites.name: The derived pushforward of a complex consisting of f-acyclic modules is computed by the ordinary pushforward termwise
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces to f-acyclicity of quasi-coherent modules.

standard_prerequisites.name: Higher direct images of quasi-coherent modules along affine morphisms vanish
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives that quasi-coherent modules are f-acyclic, concluding the first proof.

standard_prerequisites.name: On affine morphisms the pushforward of quasi-coherent sheaves can be computed on affine covers

core_obligations: First proof: quasi-coherent modules are f-acyclic for affine f by the relative affine vanishing lemma, so the acyclicity lemma computes Rf_*F^bullet as the termwise f_* (proof lines 860-861).
Alternative proof: work affine locally on S and use the quasi-coherence pushforward lemma (proof lines 862-863).
proof_roadmap: Combine the acyclicity criterion with f-acyclicity of quasi-coherent modules (proof lines 860-861).
Note the alternative affine-local argument (proof lines 862-863).
